listSites.description: List the sites of your organization with their verification status. Returns one page; pass page.next_cursor back as cursor for the next page.

getSite.description: Get one site: hostname, verification status and settings.

listWarmRuns.description: List the warm runs of a site, newest first. Returns one page; pass page.next_cursor back as cursor.

getWarmRun.description: Get one warm run: status, timing, counts per cache state, the fail-on list that was applied and the verdict. Start here, then use list_warm_run_results filtered to a state for details.

listWarmRunResults.description: List the per-URL results of a warm run. Filter by state to keep the answer small. Returns one page; pass page.next_cursor back as cursor.

listCacheStatusReports.description: List the cache status reports of a site, newest first.

getCacheStatusReport.description: Get one cache status report. A hit is verified only at the vantage point that made the request.

listSchedules.description: List the warm schedules of a site.

createWarmRun.description: WRITE: start a warm run for a verified site. This sends real requests to the site's origin and CDN and consumes warm-request quota of your plan. Repeating the call with the same idempotency_key does not start a second run. The call returns at once; poll get_warm_run for the result.

cancelWarmRun.description: WRITE: ask a running warm run to stop. Cancelling is asynchronous; poll get_warm_run. Requests already sent still count against quota.

createSchedule.description: WRITE: create a recurring warm schedule for a site. Every scheduled run sends real requests to the site and consumes quota.

updateSchedule.description: WRITE: change a warm schedule (cadence, options, enabled flag). Future runs use the new values and consume quota.

deleteSchedule.description: WRITE: delete a warm schedule. This cannot be undone.
